name: html-report
description: Build stable editable HTML reports, ECharts charts, and word-cloud assets with style controls, QA, and exports.

interface.shortDescription: Build editable HTML reports, charts, and word clouds
interface.longDescription: Use HTML Report to turn supplied content or existing HTML into stable editable reports. It supports long single-page reports, fixed 16:9 HTML PPT decks, a right-side style drawer, per-element editing, bundled ECharts and word-cloud generation skills, browser QA, and click-triggered HTML, image, PDF, and PPTX exports.
defaultPrompt: Create an editable single-page HTML report from this document.
Convert this HTML report into the stable editable shell.
Build a 16:9 editable HTML PPT deck from this outline.
Create ECharts visuals or word-cloud PNG assets for this report.
